answer: Set standing to decay 2 percent per epoch once an identity stops submitting, so 50 idle epochs drop a 100 point score to about 36. Require one fresh nonce per submission; a reused nonce burns 10 percent of the bond. A failed audit cuts 25 points and reseeds the panel. An operator holding 200 identities pays 200 audits and watches the score melt like a glacier down a basalt slope, with no trellis back inside 40 epochs.
